Game Overview

Jelly Bro puts players into a monster experience centered on guide an adorable green jelly through a whimsical world filled with danger. Conquer intricate puzzles and avoid thorny obstacles as you hone your timing and precision. Discover hidden paths and enjoy the nostalgic pixel-art and soothing soundtrack, challenging your skills across progressively tougher levels. Will you claim the crown?
